subject.title: feat: add jsonl support to memory indexer

question: Should builtin `memorySearch.extraPaths` index arbitrary JSONL records, including raw message-hook logs, or should that workflow remain outside builtin memory?
rationale: The feature expands what structured and potentially sensitive content is retained in semantic memory, while current session JSONL support is separate from arbitrary extra paths.

options.title: Approve bounded builtin JSONL support
options.body: Define the record, privacy, and retrieval contract, then implement complete JSONL support across admission, parsing, indexing, reads, watches, docs, and tests.

options.title: Keep builtin memory Markdown-oriented
options.body: Document the supported session-memory, QMD, conversion, or plugin workflow for raw structured logs rather than indexing arbitrary JSONL.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded builtin JSONL support
recommendation.body: Define the record, privacy, and retrieval contract, then implement complete JSONL support across admission, parsing, indexing, reads, watches, docs, and tests.
